en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 聊天新增持久化的每轮用量卡片，显示 Token、缓存命中、费用与输出速度。
- 修复编程 Agent 用量归属、单次费用与累计统计，保留中断任务用量并更新延迟返回的统计。
- 群聊回复气泡新增每轮用量卡片，加载历史消息时可恢复显示。
- 自定义模型定价支持选择已配置的供应商和模型，保留手动输入 ID 并改善加载失败提示。
- 修复 Codex 上下文超限后的会话恢复，下一条消息使用新上下文继续，并保留 Studio 历史与工作区。
- 修复 Grok 使用 DeepSeek Chat Completions 时的消息角色兼容问题。
- 修复同一连接切换 Profile 后会话历史空白的问题。
- 统一 Studio 抽屉尺寸和工作区选择器布局，修复群聊 Agent 设置抽屉的遮挡与加载问题，并避免回车误提交会话重命名。
What's Changed
- [codex] show persisted usage and token speed for completed runs by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3241
- [codex] fix Grok requests to DeepSeek Chat Completions by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3244
- Fix agent usage attribution, interrupted cards and cumulative totals by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3246
- fix(coding-agent): recover normal turns after context overflow by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3204
- fix(chat-run): allow reading a session owned by another profile on the same socket by @lioraluo920-dev in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3242
- Add group chat Token cards inside reply bubbles by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3248
- [codex] fix Studio drawers and workspace picker UI by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3247
- feat(usage): select configured providers and models for pricing by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3253
- chore: release Studio 0.7.27 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3255
New Contributors
- @lioraluo920-dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3242
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.26...v0.7.27
